description: Implementation of an in-memory storage grain for Orleans, providing methods for reading, writing, and deleting grain state with etag validation and logging.

classes.name: MemoryStorageGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing in-memory storage for grain state, supporting read, write, and delete operations with concurrency control via ETags.

methods.name: ReadStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the state of a grain identified by the given key and returns it wrapped in IGrainState.

methods.name: WriteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously writes or updates the grain state associated with a key, validating ETag for concurrency control.

methods.name: DeleteStateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the state of a grain by setting its stored value to null, with ETag validation.

methods.name: NewEtag
methods.description: Generates a new unique ETag string using GUID.

methods.name: GetETagFromStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the current ETag for a specified grain store key.

methods.name: ValidateEtag
methods.description: Validates the provided ETag against the current storage ETag to ensure concurrency safety.
